page.overview:
What is Gold Island?

The Gold Island is the island where Woonan lived and died. Woonan was famed to have hidden all of his treasures there, but in fact he returned all the gold he stole to its original owners before passing away.

Gold Island is small and relatively uninhabited, with no known civilizations or communities found native to the island. It is mostly covered in normal deciduous greenery and some rocky areas. Other than its few landmarks, there is nothing remarkable about Gold Island's structure.

The only known inhabitants of the island were Woonan and Ganzo when they were kids.
